goal: Run Phase 5 UI QA for Context Hub, graph interactions, source library, parser status, and evidence-reference flows.
non_goals: Do not approve replacement readiness when P0 functional blockers remain.
Do not replace final all-up UI QA.
Do not build signed or release APKs.
Do not modify existing mobile/ Capacitor/PWA release packaging.
Do not touch signing files, alias reverse-tutor, or existing applicationId com.reversetutor.app.
Do not mark native replacement readiness unless this is an explicitly approved Phase 6 readiness task with complete evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Phase 5 UI QA covers Context Hub, graph interactions, source library, parser status, and evidence-reference flows.
Screenshots or explicit unavailable-device notes are recorded for the Phase 5 UI surface matrix.
Dynamic type, dark mode, touch targets, IME behavior where relevant, and error/empty/loading states are checked.
No prohibited package/signing/PWA release changes are made.
verification_expectations: Run Compose/UI state tests where available.
Run .\gradlew.bat test lint :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon --stacktrace when feasible for the owning native project state.
Capture screenshots on small phone/main phone/emulator when feasible, or record unavailable-device notes.
Check touch targets, dynamic type, dark mode, IME where relevant, and safe area behavior.
notes: Added as a Phase 5 UI/UX follow-up before the all-up NATIVE-UX-006 final UI QA matrix.
Use deterministic tests and fakes; real LLM/provider/network/device actions require explicit scope and evidence.
